# lakekeeper_tag_definition (Data Source)

The `lakekeeper_tag_definition` data source retrieves a governance tag definition by ID or name.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag/operation/get_tag_definition)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_tag_definition" "pii" {
  project_id = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  name       = "pii.classification"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the tag definition belongs to.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the tag definition. Configure exactly one of `tag_definition_id` or `name`.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The UUID of the tag definition. Configure exactly one of `tag_definition_id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_values` (Set of String) Permitted values for an `enumerated` tag definition.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the tag definition.
- `id` (String) The ID of the tag definition, in the form `{{project_id}}/{{tag_definition_id}}`.
- `scope` (Set of String) Target types this tag definition may be applied to.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was last updated.
- `value_kind` (String) How values of this tag definition are constrained.
